metric_semantics.behavior: Cumulative event means differenced with frames at 10-update endpoints; includes exploration and episode resets.
metric_semantics.stationary_10s: Complete 10s quiet windows, after 2s zero visible command warmup, height error <=10mm; anchored at eligible-window entry. Zeros without samples are excluded.
metric_semantics.release_posture: Conditional native phase means weighted by policy-rate lane-frame samples; these sample counts are not completed-window counts.
metric_semantics.pitch_roll_scope: Native separated pitch/roll exists only for release_stop phases. Other groups expose cumulative lifetime tilt maxima, not separate pitch/roll.

windows.interpretation: Actor has only just restarted; this short exploratory training window has no quality or qualification conclusion.

totals.counter_scope: Native episode counters differenced across endpoints; boundary truncations are separate from failures.

interpretation: Actor has only just restarted; no quality or qualification conclusion.

latest_cumulative_behavior.scope: Cumulative since this worker started, INCLUDING critic-only updates; not a tail-window difference.

latest_native_rollout_window.scope: Only CRC-validated records within the bounded tail; per-tag completeness is reported.

baseline_interval.interpretation: Pure actor interval after a cumulative baseline that included critic warmup; exploration and resets remain. No quality or qualification conclusion.
